summary: Notes the Kerberos guidance assumes MIT Kerberos; FreeBSD and macOS use Heimdal, which behaves similarly but may differ.
questions: Does the Kerberos guide apply to macOS or FreeBSD?

answer_card.title: MIT Kerberos vs Heimdal
answer_card.answer_md: The guide assumes **MIT Kerberos** (default on most Linux). FreeBSD and macOS use **Heimdal**, which is similar but may behave differently in places.
